verdicts.decision_note: The exchange establishes the implementation-relevant obligation to create a magazine template and assemble the provided content and assets into a formatted issue.
The client makes the supplied Flat Plan the concrete structural basis for arranging the magazine.
The client replaces the applicable layout reference with the most recent Flat Plan; overwriting arrangement_basis leaves no stale attribute requiring removal.
First concrete client verification that the delivered page structure and article flow formed a polished, cohesive magazine.
